answer: To enforce Sybil resistance, we bind each identity to staking collateral verified via a zero-knowledge delay function, preventing rapid replication. If adversaries wander from this protocol, a gale of subgame-perfect slashing penalties triggers, liquidating their capital. This renders any multi-identity strategy an unprofitable relic of inefficient resource allocation. Consequently, the unique Nash equilibrium guarantees that the expected utility of identity multiplication remains strictly negative.
